description: LITERATURE-GROUNDED negation ladder for histopath. Cue terms verbatim from Panicek & Hricak (AJR 2016) certainty lexicon and NegEx/ConText (Chapman 2001; Harkema 2009).

present: findings consistent with malignancy on histopathology
probable: findings probably representing malignancy on histopathology
possible: malignancy cannot be excluded on histopathology
unlikely: histopathology findings unlikely to represent malignancy
absent_evidential: no evidence of malignancy on histopathology
histopathology shows no evidence of malignancy
historical: history of malignancy, resolved on histopathology
prior malignancy, no longer seen on histopathology
history of malignancy, resolved on histopathology
prior malignancy, no longer seen on histopathology
